Anthony Davidson's teammate for the whole 2008 season was **Takuma Sato**. Davidson drove only for Super Aguri that year, and the teammates lookup lists Sato as his only teammate.

The career record shows Davidson raced just 4 Grands Prix for Super Aguri in 2008, so he did not complete the season. The database has no record of a second driver for him, and it shows no 2008 entry for Sakon Yamamoto, who I'd expect to have replaced him for the rest of the year. That gap is in the data, so I can't confirm the replacement from these tools, but it doesn't change the answer: Sato is the only teammate recorded for Davidson in 2008.

ANSWER: Takuma Sato
